supportedFacts: The selected YouTube period still reports 15,037 views, 22.8 watch hours and net +2 subscribers. It ends October 10 and excludes today.
The rolling YouTube 48-hour total is 5,837, compared with 4,379 at 19:13:52 UTC. The difference 1,458 is not an interval-earned view count.

The control shows 285 TikTok views, 6.49 seconds average watch, 10.3% full video and its largest audience drop at 2 seconds. Anubis shows 310 views, 5.77 seconds average watch, 19.4% full video and its largest drop at 3 seconds.
Both detailed TikTok posts show 0 new followers. For You accounts for 99.7% of the control distribution and 99.4% for Anubis; smaller source shares retain native less-than precision.
Door, teaser and Knife TikTok posts are approximately 1.11, 2.31 and 3.11 hours old in the list observation. None of those observations completes a four-hour post review.
hypotheses: Bringing continuous action into the opening may reduce the control's early audience loss; the existing approved direct-exchange variant is the single test of this idea.
The shorter Anubis runtime may contribute to its higher full-video percentage. Its lower absolute average watch time and different age, story and distribution prevent a format-winner conclusion.
learningAudits.bottleneck: Audience loss in the opening 2-3 seconds remains the clearest observed creative weakness on the two detailed TikTok posts. Exact curves and comparable same-age cohorts remain incomplete.
learningAudits.decision: Inconclusive. Keep the existing single direct-exchange opening test; no winning format, causal improvement or failed format established.
learningAudits.test: Use the already approved 7.85-second direct-exchange variant only after the control 24-hour review. Preserve the approved wording, layout and replay disclosure. No new variant commissioned.
learningAudits.evaluation: Compare the same platform and native metric definitions at actual publication +4/24/72/168 hours. Use views, absolute average watch, full-video percentage, supported retention and followers together. Shorter runtime and sequential audiences confound interpretation.

checkpoints.note: Use each verified native publication time. The control timestamp is minute precision; collect after the end of that minute. Pending publication-age reviews remain separate from this graph audit.
